name: Lying Leg Raise
steps: Lie on your back on a mat or flat bench, hands under your hips or holding the bench.
Press your lower back down and keep legs straight with a soft knee bend.
Breathe out and raise your legs until they point to the ceiling.
Lower them slowly, stopping before your lower back lifts.
cues: Breathe out as the legs rise

common_mistakes.mistake: Lower back arching as the legs go down
common_mistakes.fix: Stop the legs higher or bend the knees more

common_mistakes.mistake: Swinging the legs up with momentum
common_mistakes.fix: Pause at the bottom and lift with control

common_mistakes.mistake: Legs crashing back to the floor
common_mistakes.fix: Take 3 seconds to lower each rep
